prompt: Complete a static paint method that builds a rounded frame by filling a large blue round-rectangle and then a smaller white one inside it.
explanation: fillRoundRect takes the usual x, y, width and height plus the horizontal and vertical diameters of the corner arcs, so passing arc for both gives circular corners. Drawing a smaller shape of the background colour on top of a larger one is the simplest way to make a frame: the difference between the two is what stays visible. With arc 0 the corners are square, which is why the corner pixel changes colour in the second case.
hints: fillRoundRect(x, y, width, height, arcWidth, arcHeight) -- the last two are the corner arc diameters.
The inner rectangle starts at (inset, inset) and is 2 * inset smaller in both directions.
Draw the inner shape after the outer one, in the background colour, so it punches a hole.
